gold_note: Ceratosaur strict consensus, panel B: a 19-way polytomy from Camarillasaurus to Majungasaurus. CERATOSAURIA is printed under the stem that enters the fan, but panel A of the same figure prints it at the node that also holds Limusaurus, so the figure does not fix which node it names and it is not encoded.
